v44 post-filter rejected samples (GUI arenas)
These are the answers that would actually become the rejected side of a training pair, i.e. what survives all three guards: GT box at least 15 coordinate units on its short side, no sampled-answer consensus pointing elsewhere, and the point more than max(10px, 20% of the box) outside the box. Green = GT box (solid guides), red cross = the model answer (dashed guides). The pre-filter audit page shows how noisy this looked before.
